title: Lower selected BIT fixed routes to charged stream primitives
body:
The selected BIT stock argument assumes a physical implementation of its header routes. PR2140 supplies the selected port 8 low/high carry interpreter and leaves payload routing open. This contribution compiles the retained catalogue into fixed column words and gives an explicit sequential reduction, conditional on the completed ordinary interchange and complete GL high-fiber premises.

I compile 999 data route types and 124 hosted types, covering all 126,432 hosted owner occurrences. I choose hosted completions by exchanging the two coordinate-set differences: one axis swap for local-overlap slots and eight for exterior slots. The endpoint projector stays the same under PR442's correlated-helper contract. I count at most 3,520 ordinary calls per data action and 1,664 per hosted action; the package also counts ordered shifts, unit passes and low-class permutations.

I verified exact rational products and selected-source bindings, 288 payload additions, 90 scalings, and complete GL2 packet permutations including width one. The addition cases move 2,957,760 bits. The controls reject omitted carries, carries read from updated low classes, wrong hosted-factor order and a missing support swap. The simulator uses a charged exact oracle for the inherited ordinary callee; the written proof charges counter work, rewinds and scratch cleanup separately from its payload meter.

Local verification passed:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-stream-routes
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-bit-stream-routes/verify.py
git diff --cached --check
```

The ten-file package adds only `research/selected-bit-stream-routes/`. I started from canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, and refreshed main before submission. The selected frontier and frozen inputs stay unchanged. [Discussion2149](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2149) contains coordination and the handoff.

The remaining obligations include good-child normalizers depending on the current matrix, weighted recursive calls and bad-residue fallback, fresh child-weight reads, COPY/ERASE lifetimes, and the finite orthogonal-cover to stopped-GL domain bridge. I claim no new supplier or exponent. The generic stream lemma and high-field complexity bound already appear in retained sources; this contribution supplies the selected route catalogue, payload realization, support completion and explicit bill.

Prepared by Jose Manuel (`@jmbarrancoml`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. I retain credit for Nick Petalas's PR2140 carry lowering and PR2120 stock analysis, Adam Gall's stock/borrowing boundary, DreamingOfClouds' PR589 tuning of eumemic's PR555 word, the punctured interface and chain, DaysSky's PR442 hosting theorem, Zhihao Chen's geometry, Dylan Crow's Hamming E8 producer and Jacob Sussman's E8/frame interfaces. `SOURCES.json` pins inputs and predecessor heads. Apache-2.0; no independent human review or hosted CI pass claimed.
